title: Resource Handles and Unlocking Early
goal: Learn how RAII guards release locks automatically and how to drop them early.

sections.text: Rust uses RAII (Resource Acquisition Is Initialization). Types like MutexGuard hold locks and release them when dropped.

sections.caption: The mutex lock is tied to the scope of guard.

sections.text: Holding a lock across long operations causes contention. You can unlock early using block scopes or `std::mem::drop`.

sections.caption: std::mem::drop releases the mutex lock immediately.

sections.text: Restricting resource lifetimes prevents deadlocks and reduces memory footprint in performance critical loops.

explanation: Learn how RAII guards release locks automatically and how to drop them early.
